content.value_statement: Website page inventories are difficult to build from nested sitemaps. SitemapKit discovers sitemap files and extracts deduplicated URLs through three focused MCP tools.
actual_capabilities: Discovers sitemap files through robots.txt, common paths, and sitemap indexes.
Extracts URLs from a specified sitemap, including entries from nested indexes.
Returns optional last-modified metadata for extracted URL entries.
Combines sitemap discovery and extraction into a deduplicated full-site URL list.
Reports truncation status, processed sitemap counts, and remaining request quota.
limitations: Requires a valid SitemapKit API key and network access to the SitemapKit service.
Runs discovery and extraction on demand and does not create monitoring jobs.
Ignores URL paths when using discovery or full-crawl tools.
Request quotas and maximum URL counts depend on the selected SitemapKit plan.

use_cases.title: Build an SEO URL Inventory
use_cases.description: Discover every published sitemap and compile a deduplicated list of indexed page URLs.

use_cases.title: Review Website Structure
use_cases.description: Inspect sitemap sources, nested files, page counts, and modification dates before a migration.

use_cases.title: Collect Research Sources
use_cases.description: Extract a bounded URL set from a public website for later review and classification.

prompt_templates.title: Find Sitemaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Find all sitemap files for [website URL] and list each discovery source.
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with sitemap discovery for one domain.

prompt_templates.title: Extract One Sitemap
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract up to [maximum URLs] entries from [sitemap URL]. Include available last-modified dates and report truncation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review the contents of a known sitemap file.

prompt_templates.title: Inventory a Website
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a deduplicated inventory for [website URL], limited to [maximum URLs]. Summarize sitemap counts, URL totals, truncation, and quota.
prompt_templates.scenario: Build a broad page inventory across all discovered sitemaps.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Sitemap Coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Crawl [website URL] up to [maximum URLs]. Group results by path pattern and identify stale sections using available last-modified dates.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use extracted sitemap data for an advanced content audit.

output_examples.output: Found two sitemap files through robots.txt and a sitemap index. The response lists both sitemap URLs and the remaining monthly quota.

output_examples.input: Extract up to 1,000 URLs from the product sitemap.
output_examples.output: Extracted 842 URLs from three processed sitemap files. Available last-modified dates appear beside each URL, and the result was not truncated.

output_examples.input: Create a full website inventory with a 5,000 URL limit.
output_examples.output: The crawl discovered six sitemaps and returned 5,000 deduplicated URLs. The result was truncated, so a higher limit may return more pages.

best_practices: Provide complete HTTPS URLs and use an exact sitemap URL for extraction.
Set a practical maximum URL count and report when results are truncated.
Review remaining quota before repeating large discovery or extraction requests.
anti_patterns: Do not describe an on-demand crawl as continuous sitemap monitoring.
Do not expect discovery or full crawl to preserve a path supplied after the domain.
Do not request excessive URL limits without considering plan limits and output size.

faq.question: What credentials does SitemapKit require?
faq.answer: It requires a SitemapKit API key supplied through the SITEMAPKIT_API_KEY environment variable.

faq.question: Which tool should find sitemap files?
faq.answer: Use discover_sitemaps to check robots.txt, common locations, and sitemap indexes for a domain.

faq.question: Can it extract a specific sitemap?
faq.answer: Yes. Use extract_sitemap with the complete sitemap URL and an optional maximum URL count.

faq.question: Can it list all pages for a website?
faq.answer: The full_crawl tool discovers sitemaps and returns a deduplicated URL list up to the requested limit.

faq.question: Does it monitor sitemap changes?
faq.answer: No. These tools run on demand and do not create scheduled monitoring jobs.

faq.question: Why might the result omit URLs?
faq.answer: Results can be truncated by the requested maximum or by limits associated with the SitemapKit plan.
